scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/client --noEmit && tsc -p smart-tests && tsc -p apps/web/worker && npm run email:typecheck
scripts.db:test: supabase db reset && docker exec -i supabase_db_langquest-next psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < server/smoke.sql && docker exec -i supabase_db_langquest-next psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < server/library-smoke.sql && docker exec -i supabase_db_langquest-next psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < server/diag-smoke.sql && docker exec -i supabase_db_langquest-next psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < server/delete-account-smoke.sql && docker exec -i supabase_db_langquest-next psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < server/moderation-smoke.sql && docker exec -i supabase_db_langquest-next psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < server/inviteKeysSmoke.sql && docker exec -i supabase_db_langquest-next psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < server/joinSmoke.sql && npm run db:parity
scripts.db:parity: tsx scripts/record-parity-sql.ts .record-parity.sql && docker exec -i supabase_db_langquest-next psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < .record-parity.sql; s=$?; rm -f .record-parity.sql; exit $s
scripts.test:integration: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$(supabase status -o json | node -e "process.stdin.on('data',d=>console.log(JSON.parse(d).ANON_KEY))") SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=$(supabase status -o json | node -e "process.stdin.on('data',d=>console.log(JSON.parse(d).SERVICE_ROLE_KEY))") vitest run packages/client/test/integration.test.ts
scripts.snapshot: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=$(supabase status -o json | node -e "process.stdin.on('data',d=>console.log(JSON.parse(d).SERVICE_ROLE_KEY))") tsx server/snapshotWorker.ts
scripts.import:v2: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=$(supabase status -o json | node -e "process.stdin.on('data',d=>console.log(JSON.parse(d).SERVICE_ROLE_KEY))") tsx server/importV2.ts
scripts.reconcile: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=$(supabase status -o json | node -e "process.stdin.on('data',d=>console.log(JSON.parse(d).SERVICE_ROLE_KEY))") tsx server/blobReconciler.ts
scripts.email:deploy: npm run email:typecheck && node scripts/cloudflare-deploy.mjs apps/invite-email/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.email:deploy:preview: npm run email:typecheck && node scripts/cloudflare-deploy.mjs apps/invite-email/wrangler.jsonc preview
scripts.web:deploy: npm run web:build && node scripts/cloudflare-deploy.mjs apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.web:deploy:preview: npm run build:preview -w web && node scripts/cloudflare-deploy.mjs apps/web/wrangler.jsonc preview
